invented.quote: The 9 new clinics we added made up for that loss. That's why revenue is flat and not down.
invented.why: The brief does not say what the 9 new clinics or the other 3 lost clinics paid, nor whether existing customers changed their spending, so it cannot be worked out that the 9 new clinics alone offset the total lost revenue.

invented.quote: Records vendors are bundling scheduling, and it's hard to compete with "good enough and already included" for chains that already run everything inside one system. Independent and smaller clinics are a different situation
invented.why: The brief only states that one customer moved to the scheduler built into their electronic records system, and says nothing about broader industry bundling trends or the differences between chains and independent or smaller clinics.

invented.quote:
1. It's the part of our product with proven, measurable value.
2. It lets us sell to clinics that are happy with their current scheduler, including the ones built into records systems, so we don't have to compete with those schedulers head-on.
invented.why: The brief states that the company will sell the reminder feature on its own next month, but does not give the founder's reasons for doing so or state that the standalone feature can integrate with other schedulers.
The brief does not give the founder's name.
